"How good was Thierry Henry in the UEFA Champions League?
We're looking back at one of Europe's finest ever players; from the electrifying nights under the Highbury lights, to the grand stages of the continent.
A star for Monaco, Arsenal and Barcelona, Henry has given European football so much and now we're celebrating the career of one of football's most elegant attackers.
What is your favourite moment of Thierry Henry's Champions League career? Let us know in the comments down below!
